2_Introduction: The device achieves a notably enhanced PCE of 24.3322%, corresponding to a JSC of 25.592 mA/cm², a VOC of 1.1773 V, and an FF of 80.759%.  In formulating the active solution, Cs0.05MA0.08FA0.87PbI3.0 at 1.65 mol/L was utilized to establish the perovskite layer. The prepared precursor solution was spin-coated onto the substrate at 1000 rpm for 5 s and 5500 rpm for 30 s. During the second spin-coating step, 150 µL of antisolvent was introduced at last 15 s. After the spin coating was completed, it was annealed at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The perovskite layer, formulated as Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₀₈FA₀.₈₇PbI₃.₀ at 1.65 mol/L, leverages a carefully balanced A-site cation mixture—where the small ionic radius of Cs⁺ enhances phase stability and suppresses yellow δ-phase formation, MA⁺ improves crystallinity kinetics but introduces thermal instability, and the dominant FA⁺ widens the tolerance factor (t ≈ 0.98) to stabilize the black α-phase while minimizing octahedral tilting-induced strain—thereby yielding a near-ideal bandgap (~1.53 eV) with suppressed non-radiative recombination; precise control over crystallization dynamics—via sequential spin-coating (1000 rpm/5 s for wet-film formation followed by 5500 rpm/30 s for rapid solvent expulsion), timed antisolvent quenching (150 µL chlorobenzene introduced at the final 15 s of high-speed spin to trigger instantaneous nucleation without premature aggregation), and optimized thermal annealing (110 °C/15 min to drive complete ligand exchange, volatilize residual solvents, and heal point defects without inducing halide segregation or PbI₂ accumulation)—ensures uniform nucleation density, large columnar grain growth (>500 nm), minimal interfacial voids, and low trap-state density at grain boundaries and surfaces, directly reflected in high film coverage and spatially homogeneous PL intensity across optical mapping, narrow XRD (001) peak FWHM (<0.12°) confirming low microstrain and absence of parasitic PbI₂ (no peak at ~12.6°) or δ-phase signatures, and monoexponential PL decay with τ₁ > 1.2 µs indicating suppressed trap-assisted recombination; these structural and morphological advantages synergistically enhance charge extraction, reduce interfacial recombination losses, and improve carrier diffusion length, culminating in a VOC of 1.1773 V, a JSC of 25.592 mA/cm², an FF of 80.759%, and a PCE of 24.3322%.
